items.title: Clean Messy Data with Python: Spaces, Duplicates, Dates and Text Numbers (pandas for Beginners)
items.description:
Clean a messy spreadsheet export with pandas, step by step: 1,000 orders with extra spaces, random capitals, duplicates, dates in three formats, prices stored as text and empty cells, cleaned into 892 trustworthy rows. Includes the three mistakes that make cleaning code silently do nothing or crash, and every output on screen is the real result of the code shown.

Install
pip install pandas

clean.py (full script)
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("orders.csv")
print("Before:", df.shape)

# 1. Text: trim spaces, fix capitals
df["Customer"] = df["Customer"].str.strip().str.title()
df["City"] = df["City"].str.strip().str.title()
df["Status"] = df["Status"].str.strip().str.lower()
df["Status"] = df["Status"].replace({"shiped": "shipped"})

# 2. Duplicates
df = df.drop_duplicates()

# 3. Dates
df["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Date"], format="mixed")

# 4. Numbers stored as text
df["Price"] = df["Price"].str.replace("$", "").str.replace(",", "")
df["Price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Price"])

# 5. Empty cells
df = df.dropna(subset=["Customer", "Qty"])
df["City"] = df["City"].fillna("Unknown")
df["Qty"] = df["Qty"].astype(int)

print("After:", df.shape)
print("Empty cells left:", df.isna().sum().sum())
df.to_csv("orders_clean.csv", index=False)
print("Saved orders_clean.csv")

Health check (run this first)
print(df.duplicated().sum())
print(df["City"].nunique())
print(df.isna().sum())
print(df["Status"].value_counts())

The three mistakes
1. Forgetting to save the result: df["City"].str.strip() alone changes nothing. Write df["City"] = df["City"].str.strip().
2. Removing duplicates before fixing the text: 29 found instead of 60. Fix the text first.
3. Numbers stored as text: pd.to_numeric fails on "$34.90". Remove "$" and "," first.
Bonus: pd.to_datetime needs format="mixed" when dates come in different styles (add dayfirst=True for day-first dates).

Pro tip: on the messy file, revenue by city showed 50 cities and 555,982.90 in sales. On the clean file: 7 cities (counting Unknown) and 783,255.00.
